subject: Soluna Health — Sales → Success transfer: validation & kickoff prep
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rivera <elena.rivera@solunahealth.com>, Tom Matthews <tmatthews@solunahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Soluna Health — Sales → Success transfer: validation & kickoff prep

Team — transferring this one to Success for kickoff scheduling and implementation planning. Summary and asks below: 

Quick context
- Account: Soluna Health (behavioral telehealth provider)
- ARR: $425k (annual recurring) 
- Contract signed: 2026-07-06 (SOW attached, v2)
- Primary contacts: Elena Rivera (Head of Product), Tom Matthews (Director of Ops)

Commitments and baseline scope (from SOW)
- Phase 1 (30 days): API integration for session metadata, embedding-based search for care notes, and 2 pilot clinics (10k monthly tokens estimate)
- Phase 2 (60–90 days): Expanded model routing, SLA 99.5% for core inference; Dedicated capacity evaluation if usage grows

Primary risks / open items
- Security: They requested network architecture details and audit logs — see attached Network_Security_Sheet.xlsx. They flagged SOC 2 evidence as a gating item for Phase 2.
- Data residency: Production must run in us-west region per Tom.
- Quotas: initial token volume might spike during pilot; recommend temporary burst policy.

Internal asks (please reply inline):
1) Grace — can you own customer kickoff and steward CS lead? If yes, set proposed 1-hour kickoff next week.
2) Karthik — confirm implementation lead and first-sprint acceptance criteria; any prework required from infra?
3) Mina — can you confirm who will own API handoff docs and sample integration templates?

Attachments: Soluna_SOW_v2.pdf (signed), Network_Security_Sheet.xlsx
Related links: HubSpot deal and Drive folder linked below.

Goal: run a kickoff Wk of Jul 13, confirm owners & acceptance criteria by EOD Jul 9 so we can schedule.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rivera <elena.rivera@solunahealth.com>, Tom Matthews <tmatthews@solunahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Soluna Health — Sales → Success transfer: validation & kickoff prep

Thanks Mateo — happy to own this. 

I will: 
- Set up a 60-minute kickoff with Elena & Tom (propose Tue Jul 14 at 10am PT / Wed Jul 15 10am ET) and invite Karthik + Mina.
- Draft a 30-day success plan with acceptance criteria and share before kickoff.
- Triage security questions with Security team and provide a short deliverable list by Jul 9 COB.

Prelim questions for the team: 
- Does Soluna expect we host any customer data in their VPC or do they only call our hosted endpoints? (Mateo — any notes from procurement?)
- Karthik — what does the staging -> prod promotion cadence look like for a pilot like this?
- Mina — can you surface the SDK samples and API runbook; if possible drop a link to the integration templates before the kickoff.

Elena / Tom — can you confirm the two pilot clinics (names & environments) and whether engineering has a contact who will join the kickoff?

I’ll produce a short Handoff Readout document and share it with the team before invites go out.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rivera <elena.rivera@solunahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Soluna Health — Sales → Success transfer: validation & kickoff prep

Grace — agreed, I can be implementation lead on this one. Notes: 
- Environment: per contract, they will call our hosted API in us-west; no VPC initial requirement documented. If they later request Private deployment, we’ll evaluate during Phase 2.
- Staging cadence: we usually run a 2-week sprint for pilot with a preflight checklist (integration smoke tests, KV cache warmup, latency baseline). I’ll attach the checklist into the Drive folder today.
- Acceptance criteria (draft): 
  * Successful API auth and token issuance for two dev engineers
  * Embedding search returns 95% precision on 100-item test set (customer-provided)
  * End-to-end latency under 700ms p50 for interactive calls

Open item: Elena — we’ll need the sample dataset (anonymized) to run the precision test. If you can drop a link with the sample by Jul 12 that would be ideal.

I’ll coordinate with Infra for any temporary burst policy and confirm the token quota recommendation by EOD Jul 9.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rivera <elena.rivera@solunahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Soluna Health — Sales → Success transfer: validation & kickoff prep

Thanks — confirmed. We can do Tue Jul 14 at 10am PT. I’m looping in our engineering lead Sam Carter (sam.carter@solunahealth.com) on the invite.

On the dataset — Sam will upload an anonymized export to the Drive link in the next 48 hours. For the pilot clinics, we’ll start with: 
- Northside Clinic (staging env: ns-stg)
- Riverbend Clinic (staging env: rb-stg)

We will review the SOW and security sheet. If you need anything else from procurement side (PO / billing cadence), Tom will follow up separately. Looking forward to the kickoff.

— Elena
Elena Rivera
Head of Product, Soluna Health

On Fri, 09 Jul 2026 at 11:05 Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Grace, Karthik — thanks for the quick turn. I’ll update HubSpot with owners and set the deal stage to "Implementation - Kickoff Scheduled."
> Elena — appreciate Sam joining; I’ll add Tom and Sam to the calendar invite.
> 
> Notes: I’ve uploaded the signed SOW and security sheet to the Drive folder and sent the DocuSign reference for your records.
> 
> Mateo
